description: Changes the words of one part of the draft script (section: its 1-based number in the Voiceover panel, or its id), the same save as the Voiceover panel's section editor. Uses no credit; undoable. A recorded voice keeps the old words until that part is recorded again (rerecord_narration_section).

text.description: The part's new words, up to 600 characters.

name: edit_narration_section
title: Change a narration part
